purpose: Define publication of a Project into FreeMarket as an explicit visibility/discovery state over an existing universal Project identity rather than creation of a separate market-task entity.

topics.name: FreeMarket Project Publication
topics.purpose: Define publication of a Project into FreeMarket as an explicit visibility/discovery state over an existing universal Project identity rather than creation of a separate market-task entity.

semantics.project_rule: Published work references an existing canonical Project identity.
semantics.publication_rule: Publication is explicit metadata/state associated with the Project/FreeMarket surface.
semantics.no_duplicate_rule: Publishing does not clone or reissue the Project as a second work identity.
semantics.visibility_rule: Publication determines discoverability subject to identity/data visibility policy.
semantics.requirement_rule: Market-facing requirements/criteria are explicit Project/FreeMarket metadata or refs.
semantics.lifecycle_rule: Published, paused, filled/assigned and closed market states are distinct from Project execution state.
semantics.authority_rule: Being able to see a published Project does not grant participation or execution authority.

invariants.rule: FreeMarket/Broker matching and ranking operate over explicit Project, identity, PortfolioCore and MeritCore semantics without creating duplicate work, identity or merit authority.

hard_gates.condition: market listing creates separate Task primitive
publication state conflated with Project execution state
Project requirements exist only as unstructured prose where machine-significant

references.purpose: FreeMarket publishes the universal Project primitive.
